9 à 12 RTT par an, Mutuelle prise à charge à 75%, Tickets Restaurant d'une valeur de 11€ (pris en charge à 50% par Sewan ), forfait mobilité durable à hauteur de 500€/ an, Chèques cadeaux de +150€, Compte Epargne Temps à disposition, crèches d'entreprise … et bien plus :)
La mobilité interne
Chaque année, ce sont 30% de salariés qui évoluent en interne. L'évolution de carrière fait partie de la philosophie de Sewan .
Un accord et une charte mobilité accompagnent l'expérience des salariés tout au long de leur vie chez Sewan .
L'esprit Sewan
Chez Sewan , nous nous engageons à garantir des processus de recrutement inclusifs et à plaider pour l’embauche et la promotion de chaque candidat de manière éthique et équitable.
Nous interdisons strictement toute discrimination à l'encontre de tout candidat à un emploi en raison de son identité ou expression de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de ses origines socio-économiques et/ou multiculturelles, de son état de santé, de son âge, de sa religion ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.
Nous sommes fiers de garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous nos candidats.
Nos engagements pour l'inclusion

· Sensibilisation des équipes Sewan à travers des conférences et des formations thématiques.

· Individualisation du processus d’intégration et suivi rapproché par la Mission Handicap interne.

· Une écoute confidentielle et un accompagnement personnalisé :
Chez Sewan , nous mettons un point d’honneur à accompagner chaque collaborateur dans son parcours professionnel, notamment les personnes en situation de handicap.
Notre référente handicap est à votre disposition pour répondre à toutes vos questions en toute confidentialité. Son rôle : garantir un accompagnement adapté à vos besoins, faciliter votre intégration au sein de nos équipes et assurer le respect de nos engagements en faveur de l’inclusion.
Engagement en faveur du handicap
Chez Sewan , nous sommes convaincus que la diversité est une richesse et nous nous engageons à favoriser l’inclusion des personnes en situation de handicap. Si vous bénéficiez de la Reconnaissance de la Qualité de Travailleur Handicapé (RQTH) et que vous avez besoin d’aménagements spécifiques dans le cadre de votre processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à l’adresse suivante avant de démarrer le processus de recrutement : .
Encouragements à candidater
Sewan souhaite donner sa chance à des personnes de tous horizons. Nous avons conscience que tout le monde ne répondra pas à l’intégralité des qualifications attendues dès le premier jour, et c'est normal. Si vous êtes attiré par le secteur de la tech et des télécommunications et que vous souhaitez développer vos compétences, nous vous encourageons vivement à postuler.
Processus de recrutement
Nous souhaitons que votre expérience de recrutement chez Sewan soit fluide et agréable. Voici les étapes clés du processus :
Préqualification téléphonique.
Deux entretiens d'embauche : un avec l'équipe recrutement et un avec votre futur manager.
Un test technique (uniquement pour certains postes techniques).
Un retour téléphonique systématique.

About Backblaze
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.
Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.
But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Staff Product Manager to join our team!

Backblaze ’s B2 cloud object storage offers multi-exabyte, S3-compatible, globally available object storage that unlocks app builder innovation across AI neoclouds and traditional hyperscalers at a fraction of the cost from traditional cloud infrastructure hyperscalers.

The Staff Product Manager for B2 will work closely with key stakeholders to understand the evolution of cloud storage and the customer problems in the space and determine product strategies and roadmap to address those problems.

He or she will work independently to lead the efforts for new feature discovery and delivery and improvements to execute on those strategies. Understanding customer problems through interviews and market research and translating them into requirements is critical.

Drive B2 product strategy and roadmap development through to delivery execution.
Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle from discovery through delivery in feature development.
Gather and synthesize inputs for discovery and prioritization from internal functions, customers, and partners across the full spectrum of R&D development of feature capabilities, user experience challenges, cost optimization, and technical debt.
Translate complex customer challenges into clear, concise and actionable product requirements in collaboration with Design, Engineering and GTM teams.
Collaborate with Product Marketing to launch and drive adoption of new products and features. Act as a subject matter expert and evangelist for Backblaze s solutions solutions, presenting to customers, prospects, partners, and to internal teams.
Establish and track key product metrics (KPIs), using data to guide iteration and growth decisions.
Maintain a deep understanding of the latest advancements in the object storage market across its application in customer use cases and competitive offerings to identify new opportunities and ensure Backblaze ’s market leadership position.

6+ years of Product Management experience in tech businesses, preferably on IaaS and/or SaaS offerings
A proven track record of successfully launching and scaling technical products / platforms in high-growth businesses involving in-depth cross-functional collaboration and leadership across R&D and go-to-market functions
Strong grasp of cloud architecture, APIs, and security and compliance
Proven success in owning product roadmaps, defining MVPs, and driving the complete product life cycle
Strategic thinker who can translate market trends, customer needs, and technical innovations into a clear product vision and actionable roadmap
Deep empathy for customers / users in gathering and synthesizing input and a passion for solving their most pressing security challenges.
Outstanding communication and leadership skills with a collaborative and team-oriented approach to identifying problems, determining potential solutions, and building consensus around your vision with internal and external stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience applying data and metrics to inform product decisions and measure success.

Expertise in cloud storage and computing from hyperscale and neocloud providers, such as AWS, Azure, GCP, GPU clouds, CDNs, etc.

MBA degree

About Decagon
Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.
Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.
We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.
We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.
Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre-sales conversation through the life of the account.
The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.
These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role.

Decagon is hiring a Senior Agent Product Manager, Healthcare to own the delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for our healthcare customers across Payer, Provider, Pharmacy, Labs, and Life Sciences. You are the primary technical and strategic owner on the account: you earn trust with the customer's leadership, scope a solution that solves their problem, and then build the working AI agent.
You will be among the first dedicated healthcare Agent PMs on the team, working alongside Healthcare product and GTM leadership to author our healthcare roadmap and strategy. You'll partner with Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers, and Agent Deployment Engineers to scale agents in production and grow them into core infrastructure for how the customer runs.
It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you've ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in healthcare, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing Agent Deployment Engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution.
In this role, you will
Own the AI transformation and technical deployment for Decagon's largest healthcare opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers, and Agent Deployment Engineers to build working agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical, compliance-gated buyers into signed customers.
Serve as the executive partner to the C-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion.
Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade agents for high-volume healthcare workflows: benefits and eligibility, claims and prior authorization status, patient access and scheduling, Rx and adherence outreach, care-gap closure, post-discharge follow-up, and HCP inquiry handling.
Own the trust posture on your accounts — PHI handling, consent, escalation to licensed clinical staff, guardrails on what an agent may and may not say, and the audit and compliance evidence that security review will ask for.
Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable healthcare assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap.
Direct Agent Deployment Engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome.
Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the healthcare product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments.
Your background looks something like this
6+ years owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives, with at least 3 of those years in healthcare. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward-deployed or solutions roles at high-growth technology companies serving healthcare organizations.
Real fluency in how healthcare actually operates — how a health plan or health system is organized, where member and patient friction lives, and how care, claims, and contact center operations connect. You can hold a substantive conversation with a clinical leader and a CIO in the same meeting.
A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it.
Strong technical acumen. You can understand and shape AI agent designs and hold your own in a technical conversation with both engineers and executives.
Experience shipping in regulated, security-reviewed environments — HIPAA, BAA, PHI minimization, SOC 2 or HITRUST — where a launch depends on privacy, legal, and clinical sign-off as much as on the build.
Executive presence and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers at large, complex organizations.
Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you implement it.
Even better
A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
A clinical, public health, or health policy background, or direct experience designing under clinical safety constraints.
An MBA, or equivalent experience at the intersection of business strategy and technology.
Experience selling, deploying, or advising on enterprise software or transformation programs at the Fortune 500 level.
First-in-vertical experience at a prior company, where you owned the pattern and not just the project.

___________________________________________________________________________ DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!
Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung
Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
Was diese Rolle nicht ist
Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich
Das bieten wir Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen
Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub (bei Vollzeit), Homeoffice-Anteil, unbefristete Festanstellung
Attraktives Einkommen sowie Benefits wie Team- und Firmenevents, Firmen-Fitnessangebot und Dienstrad-Leasing

At Groups, our mission is to deliver life-changing care to individuals struggling with substance use disorders. We are building technology-enabled care models that improve access, outcomes, and experience for our members, at scale.
We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead strategy and execution across a critical portfolio of products and platforms at the core of our clinical and operational ecosystem. This is a highly influential, senior individual contributor role with broad ownership, significant autonomy, and direct impact on how care is delivered.
The Opportunity
This is a high-impact role. You will operate at the intersection of clinical care, technology, and growth, owning a portfolio that directly shapes member engagement, clinical outcomes, and operational efficiency.
You will set direction, define success, and drive enterprise-level decisions, while raising the bar for product management across the organization.
This position is fully remote, however, for this role, we are prioritizing candidates who align with the Eastern time zone (EDT/EST) for consistent overlap and availability with our core clinical and operational teams.

What You’ll Own
Define and lead the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of interconnected products and platforms.
Own end-to-end outcomes, including performance, adoption, and impact across systems and vendor partnerships.
Establish and drive a metrics framework that sets the standard for product performance and accountability.
Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions, balancing speed, cost, and long-term scalability.
Partner with Engineering on architecture and platform decisions, ensuring alignment with business and clinical priorities.
Design member-centric experiences, including conversational and interaction flows that guide individuals to the right care at the right time.
Influence cross-functional strategy and investment decisions across Product, Clinical Operations, Growth, IT, and external partners.
Shape how adjacent teams prioritize and execute work beyond your direct scope.
Establish governance, documentation, and compliance standards to support scale in a regulated healthcare environment.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Improve member engagement and care navigation through thoughtful product design.
Drive measurable gains in clinical outcomes and operational efficiency.
Elevate product practice through data rigor, experimentation, and mentorship.
Enable smarter, faster decisions through clear metrics and actionable insights.

7–10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of platforms, infrastructure, or shared systems at scale.
Experience operating at a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior IC level.
Proven ability to define and execute portfolio-level strategy across complex, interconnected systems.
Strong track record of data-driven decision-making, including defining and operationalizing metrics.
Experience designing conversational or AI-driven user experiences (chat, voice, messaging).
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations.
Technical fluency to partner effectively on architecture, integration, and reliability trade-offs.
Demonstrated ability to raise the bar for product teams through mentorship, standards, and best practices.

Healthcare, behavioral health, or other regulated, mission-critical environments.
Experience with automation, messaging platforms, or AI-enabled product strategies.
History of insourcing vendor capabilities or rebuilding critical systems.
Contributions to scaling product organizations (hiring, leveling, coaching).
Please note: This role is not available to residents of AK, AR, CA, HI, ID, MD, NE, SD, UT, or WY.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
As a Product Manager for our eCommerce Solutions team , you will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine (our core white-label product) that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets.

Timely and High-Quality Delivery of Roadmap : Ensure the successful and timely delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. This includes:
Achieve on-time delivery of planned iterations and releases, meeting or exceeding project milestones.
Maintain a backlog of well-defined and prioritized user stories that align with customer needs and business goals.
Minimize scope changes and rework through effective communication and requirement validation.
Stakeholder Alignment : Establish strong communication channels with stakeholders and ensure a shared understanding of product vision, progress, and timelines. This includes:
Build and maintain trust-based relationships with stakeholders by providing clear, structured, and consistent communication.
Proactively address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations to ensure alignment with the product roadmap.
Data-informed decisions : Drive continuous improvement of the product through data analysis, user feedback, and iterative development cycles. This includes:
Monitor and analyze key product and team KPIs (e.g., conversion rates, user engagement) to identify opportunities for enhancement.
Utilize data insights to prioritize features and improvements that have the highest impact on user satisfaction and business goals.
Implement iterative development practices, adjusting priorities and features based on real-time feedback and changing market conditions.

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.

At least 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Owner
Have user-centric thinking: Ability to empathize with users, understand their needs, and prioritize features based on their value and impact
Strong communicator: You possess verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the product vision, requirements, and updates to both the development team and stakeholders
Know Agile Methodology: You are proficient in Agile methodologies (particularly Scrum) to manage iterative development, prioritize work, and respond to changing requirements.
Hands-on with user story writing: You are able to break down complex features into clear and concise user stories that capture user needs, acceptance criteria, and business value.
Technically savvy: You understand the technical aspects of the product domain, allowing effective translation of requirements into actionable tasks for the development team.
Data-driven decision mindset: Your skills in using data and analytics help you make informed decisions, monitor KPIs, and identify areas for product improvement.
Problem-Solving approach: You are able to identify and address challenges that arise during product development, find creative solutions, and make timely adjustments.
Adaptability: You are willing to embrace change and adapt to evolving user needs, market trends, and business priorities
Experience with B2C products is a plus.

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company

YipitData is making one of its most ambitious Product bets: building an AI-powered product that transforms how clients interact with data. This initiative sits at the center of our product strategy and represents a fundamentally new way for customers to access and derive value from our data.

This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and AI. You will work with diverse alternative datasets and develop the methodologies that transform those signals into reliable business insights. You will also serve as a key authority on how the product uses data, helping define what conclusions are methodologically sound, what questions can be answered confidently, and where appropriate guardrails should exist.
Success in this role requires both analytical rigor and a builder's mindset. You'll thrive in ambiguity, tackle problems without established playbooks, and help shape the future of one of YipitData's most strategic products. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of customers interact with our data and how this product scales over time.

Data Source Ownership & Methodology Design
Own the translation of raw alternative datasets into scalable, AIready data products.
Design methodologies that answer high-value business questions, determining how disparate datasets should be combined, normalized, and interpreted.
Partner closely with Data Engineering to shape source data pipelines into clean, well-structured datasets with clear definitions and documentation.
Develop deep expertise in the strengths, limitations, biases, and coverage characteristics of key datasets and ensure those nuances are reflected in downstream outputs.
AI Product Intelligence & Knowledge Systems
Define how the product should use different datasets, including valid query patterns, edge cases, failure modes, and methodological guardrails.
Own metric definitions, data lineage, and documentation to ensure the product consistently delivers accurate and explainable answers.
Establish standards for how the product reasons across multiple datasets, preventing over-interpretation and ensuring conclusions remain statistically defensible.
Serve as the final reviewer for methodology-related changes that impact product behavior.
Product Development & Customer Problem Solving
Translate customer questions into scalable methodologies, data models, and product capabilities.
Expand the range of questions the product can answer by enabling new forms of segmentation, cohort analysis, behavioral measurement, and cross-dataset insights.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to identify new data sources, use cases, and capabilities that increase the commercial value of the AI product.
Help shape the product roadmap by turning emerging customer needs and experimental insights into repeatable product functionality.
Data Quality & Operational Excellence
Coordinate testing and validation of staged data changes before they reach production.
Own incident management processes for data quality issues, methodology changes, and upstream source disruptions.
Build and maintain a library of quality checks tailored to the unique requirements of AI-powered customer experiences.
Ensure the product consistently surfaces reliable, accurate, and internally consistent information across all supported use cases.
You Are Likely to Succeed If You Have
3–6 years of experience in data product management, product analytics, analytics engineering, data science, market intelligence, alternative data, or a closely related field.
Strong fluency in SQL; comfort with data pipelines, schema changes, and upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Experience owning data documentation, metric definitions, or data quality programs—not just conducting ad hoc analysis.
A track record of cross-functional coordination, ideally between technical data teams and product or commercial stakeholders.
Strong project management instincts: you can run a triage process, maintain a quality library, and coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups without dropping balls.
Clear, structured communication—you can translate complex data methodology questions into guidance that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
A demonstrable track record of building—shipping things, solving hard problems, and leaving a clear mark on the products you’ve worked on.
An entrepreneurial mindset: you’re comfortable with ambiguity, energized by new problem spaces, and don’t need a fully paved road to make progress.
Deep experience with alternative data, panel data, or similarly complex, nuanced data sources is required—you need to understand the quirks, limitations, and methodological subtleties of these datasets and be able to encode that understanding for an AI driven product.
Prior experience in or exposure to AI/ML products, LLM-based agents, or evaluation frameworks is a strong plus.

About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
The Opportunity
9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com .

But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy.

You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors.

You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data.

The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

Product Strategy & Execution
Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).
Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential
Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning
Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application
Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch
Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access
Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance
Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect
Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up
Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls
Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows
Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time
Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM
Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad
Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one
Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams
Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

You'll own one of Letly's product surfaces end to end — the money surface (rent collection, deposits, landlord payouts, statements and the ledger underneath them) or the marketplace (AI-Native property management, the vendor network and the embedded products sold into a tenancy) — the product and the operation running on it.
We don't sell software to this industry, we run the industry ourselves: every product decision you make lands in a real tenancy, a real payment and a real operator's day, usually within the week.
These are mid-to-senior hires. At mid you own a surface and ship it. At senior you own a surface others depend on — you set the product patterns, take the architecture-shaped calls with engineering, and raise the bar around you.
What you'll own
The console the business runs on. The internal surface ops actually works in, whichever side you own. Every hour of manual work you design out is margin.

Rent in. Collection across thousands of tenancies — mandates, retries, part-payments and arrears — and the tenant-facing product wrapped around it.
Money out. Landlord payouts, statements, deposits and pooled client money: right to the penny, on the day we promised, compliant, and legible to a landlord who is not an accountant.
The ledger and reconciliation. A penny-accurate, self-healing ledger reconciling bank activity across every tenancy, plus the tooling ops reaches for when it doesn't match.
Money agents in production. Agents that chase arrears, answer "where is my rent", and escalate to a human. You decide what they're allowed to do, what the guardrails are, and where the handover sits.

AI-Native property management. The managed product itself — maintenance, compliance, renewals, inspections — run by agents with humans only on the exceptions, across the service ladder from self-managing to guaranteed.
The vendor network. Supply on the services side: contractors, engineers, cleaners, inventory clerks, photographers. Onboarding, pricing, SLAs, quality controls, and the routing that picks the right one without a human in the middle.
Embedded products. Insurance, compliance certificates, referencing and utilities sold into the tenancy at the moment they're needed — attach rate, take-rate and the unit economics of each.
The landlord and tenant journey. Listing → viewing → offer → referencing → contract → tenancy → renewal, built as one product across both sides of a transaction that has never been one product.
How we work
You get your own answers — query the data, read the tickets, sit with ops, do the job manually once before you specify it.
You use AI across your own work: research, specs, prototypes, analysis. We expect a PM to operate AI-Natively and run product operations.
Weekly release cadence, decisions written down, evidence over opinion.

3+ years owning product end to end in a high-growth environment (more, for senior), including at least one thing you launched from zero.
Technical range: you can intelligently discuss system design, APIs, data models and failure modes, and engineers respect your judgement.
You do your own analysis — you're comfortable in the data and you prioritise on expected impact, not on who asked.
Operational literacy: you can design a process and a product together, and you know which of the two is the right fix.
AI-Native: you use models expertly, and you can specify an agentic product — scope, guardrails, evals and failure modes included.
Depth in one of our two surfaces: either a payments, lending, insurance or banking product you owned — treating reconciliation, failure paths and regulatory constraints as product problems rather than edge cases — or supply or demand in a two-sided marketplace, with liquidity, matching, take-rate and the quality controls that keep both sides coming back.
Senior: a track record of owning a surface others depended on, and of raising the standard of the people around you.

Exposure to the other surface — money if you come from marketplaces, marketplaces if you come from money.
Property or lettings experience.
First PM into a company, or a technical degree / having shipped code yourself.
Who does well here
You own the number, not the roadmap — the roadmap is a means to it.
You go to the operation — the answer is in the property, the call recording and the ledger, not in the backlog.
You decide — with incomplete information, in writing, and you revisit when the evidence changes.
You compress — you'd rather delete a step than design a screen for it.
Why apply

You'll get to own the whole loop: build the software, run the operation on it, and watch the unit economics move. You own the output metric, not just the process. The domain is the largest financial relationship in most people's lives and for the first time in history, technology enables us to crack it. The surface you own will be one of the first parts of it to run itself.
We've raised a $4m pre-seed from investors who've built the financial and operational infrastructure that moves billions and serves millions. They backed us because the home is the largest consumer asset where that infrastructure hasn't been built yet. You'll get competitive base pay, meaningful equity, and a small, high-agency team rebuilding an industry and growing at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to facilitate this aggressive growth.

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth.
You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position.
Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda.
Key Objectives
Core Accountability
Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.
Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap
Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.
Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence
Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.
Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline
Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.
Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness
Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.
Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain

You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.

As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.

You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes.

You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers.

Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection

Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.

You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.

Coordinate asset availability and infrastructure initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Commercial, and other Product teams, ensuring dependencies, decisions, risks, and requirements are understood and tracked through delivery.
Support the setup and evolution of technical infrastructure across areas such as wallets, gas sponsorship, transaction broadcasting, and other on-chain infrastructure services, working closely with engineering and operational teams to translate requirements into scalable product solutions.

Senior Product Manager - Credit

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
What you'll be doing
As our Senior Product Manager - Credit, you'll take full ownership of our Credit business line within the Features & Payment domain, focusing on innovative solutions such as Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) to build and scale financial products for millions of users. Here's what that looks like in practice:
New Business Line Leadership – Drive the strategy and execution for BNPL products, taking features from 0 to 1 and managing their scaling phase.
Consumer-Facing Experience – Focus on the UX and customer-facing side of credit, ensuring complex financial tools are intuitive, transparent, and seamlessly integrated into Satispay.
Cross-functional Alignment – Act as a strategic orchestrator across Finance, Marketing, Data Science, and Fincrime/Fraud to align priorities around a shared product vision.
Product Definition & Documentation – Write clear user stories and requirements for Engineering, aligning frontend experiences with backend logic such as credit scoring and collection.
Data-Driven Optimization – Analyze product usage and performance metrics to optimize credit features and uncover new market opportunities.
Process Evangelism & Mentorship – Advocate for thorough documentation and efficient workflows to help the team anticipate obstacles and ensure smooth product delivery.

This role needs someone with the resilience to build a new business pillar and a problem-solving mindset focused on team-driven success.
Product Experience – 5+ years as a Product Manager, including at least 3 years specifically within the Credit domain.
Launch & Growth Track Record – Proven experience launching products from scratch and scaling them through growth phases.
Financial & Analytical Skills – Strong understanding of credit scoring, collection management, and overall financial mechanics.
Stakeholder Management – Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Engineering, UX, BI, Finance).
Language Skills – Professional fluency in English.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

About Enroly
At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

s.h: This role sits across our two core products
s.t:
CAS Shield — our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.
Apply — our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.
Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.
This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.
Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.
Your job is to make that experience work — fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.
This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.
Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.
Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.
Lead the mobile-first applicant experience — video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.
Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps — transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection — while keeping humans accountable for decisions.
Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.
Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants and internal stakeholders to understand how interviews are created, completed, reviewed and used in admissions and compliance decisions.
Lead product discovery —Conduct discovery across the full interview lifecycle, including interview creation, applicant completion, assessment, reviewer workflows and institutional decision-making.
Work day-to-day with a dedicated squad: writing and refining user stories, managing backlogs, setting acceptance criteria, and collaborating closely with developers and QA.
Prioritise and execute improvements, from bug triage and fixes to new feature delivery, based on business impact and user feedback.
Post-launch analysis: track usage, completion and assessment quality, gather feedback, and use data to continuously iterate.
Champion compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g. UKVI credibility expectations, data protection, auditability) in product decisions and design.
Be the internal advocate for interviewing at Enroly, aligning teams around shared goals and user outcomes.

High applicant completion rates and a demonstrably better interview experience, particularly on mobile.
Institutions trust the assessment output enough to make decisions on it — and can defend those decisions.
Interview integrity is measurably strong, with fraud and impersonation risk reduced without punishing genuine applicants.
Meaningful reduction in manual reviewer effort per interview.
Interviewing works as one coherent capability across CAS Shield and Apply.
Efficient prioritisation and execution of improvements and fixes.
Alignment with wider business and regulatory goals.

Building a high-stakes, high-scrutiny product area where getting it wrong has real consequences for applicants and institutions.

Delivering a reliable video and mobile experience across highly variable devices, networks and geographies.
Serving two products with different lifecycles, users and delivery rhythms.

At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements.

If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

The Profiles Platform team owns Klaviyo’s core customer data system, the foundation that powers every product experience across the platform. This team is responsible for storing, managing, and serving customer profile data as the source of truth for downstream products like segmentation, flows, reporting, and analytics.

Their work ensures that profile data is accurate, scalable, and usable across the entire product ecosystem. From improving data modeling and computed properties to enabling enterprise-scale ingestion and supporting global compliance needs, this team plays a critical role in making Klaviyo’s platform intelligent and reliable at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s Profiles Platform. In this role, you will define how customer profile data is structured, processed, and served across the platform.

You’ll work at the intersection of data infrastructure, computed data, and scalability, ensuring that profile data remains trustworthy and performant as Klaviyo grows into more complex enterprise and global use cases. This is a high-impact platform role where your work will directly influence nearly every product team and customer experience.

Please note that this is an onsite role that requires 5 days/week in our Boston office. Fully remote candidates will not be considered at this time.
How You’ll Make a Difference
Own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s core profile data system, including profile traits, transformations, and storage layers
Serve as the product owner for the source of truth for customer data across the platform
Partner closely with engineering to evolve profile data architecture and services at massive scale
Collaborate with the Identity, Data, and Consent teams to ensure accurate and unified customer records
Drive improvements in profile data quality, usability, and modeling for downstream consumers (segmentation, flows, analytics, AI)
Enable enterprise and global expansion by supporting data residency, compliance, and regional infrastructure requirements
Define and track key metrics around data quality, performance, and system efficiency
What You’ll Work On
Building a computed properties platform to support derived traits (e.g., LTV, recency/frequency, propensity scoring)
Improving profile data modeling and transformations to make data more usable across the platform
Scaling ingestion systems to support billions of profiles and high-throughput workloads
Reducing cost and improving performance through sharding, traffic smoothing, and optimized write patterns
Supporting identity quality initiatives (e.g., deduplication, multi-email profiles, probabilistic matching)
Enabling regulated and global use cases, including data residency (e.g., EU, Japan) and compliance requirements

You have 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in platform, data infrastructure, or backend systems
You have experience working on data models, pipelines, or large-scale distributed systems
You are comfortable operating in highly technical environments and partnering closely with engineering
You have experience driving cross-team alignment across multiple stakeholders
You think in terms of systems and tradeoffs (scale, cost, performance, usability)
You can balance long-term platform investments with short-term product needs
You communicate clearly and can translate complex technical concepts into business impact

Experience with customer data platforms (CDPs) or identity systems
Familiarity with data modeling, event pipelines, or storage systems (e.g., KVS, streaming ingestion)
Experience supporting enterprise-scale or high-volume systems
Exposure to AI/analytics platforms that depend on structured customer data
Experience with data residency, privacy, or compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)

El Product Owner es la persona responsable del liderazgo y de los resultados del Dev Team (Squad), direcciona el desarrollo e implementación de los nuevos productos o funcionalidades, en adición, administra el portafolio de productos en temas de prevención de vulnerabilidades y mantenimiento.
El Product Owner trabaja en equipo con el Product Manager, las áreas de operaciones, servicio, delivery y tecnología para construir de manera ágil soluciones rentables, escalables y sostenibles para el portafolio de productos asignado.

Diseño Funcional: Identificar la mejor alternativa de visualización de las funcionalidades o mejoras de producto en conjunto con el Design team que estén alineados con la experiencia del Usuario.
Definición Funcional: Definir y priorizar las features, refinar historias de usuario en conjunto con el dev team y acompañar al equipo en las necesidades que se presenten a nivel funcional durante las diferentes fases del ciclo de desarrollo de software. Definir las necesidades de integración con otras plataformas y el esquema de operación
Productividad: En conjunto con el Scrum Master Apoyar al Dev Team en la implementación de mejoras que generen una mayor productividad a través de planes de acción (retrospectivas), sinergia interna, motivación, y sinergias con otros squads.
Innovación: Estar en constante búsqueda de elementos que permitan la innovación del producto alineados con la estrategia del negocio. Generar espacios que permitan al Dev Team aportar sobre estos elementos de innovación.

About Chili Piper
Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.
We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Orchestrator, Chili Piper's GTM Control Layer.
Internally, we think of this role as a Product Market Fitter. This is not a traditional roadmap management role. It is a product leadership role for someone who loves building complex, enterprise-grade products and has the judgment to turn customer and market evidence into focused product bets that drive real adoption and business impact.
Orchestrator listens for signals across Chili Piper and external tools, decides what should happen next, and takes the action itself. That includes catching a form abandonment, a no-show, a missed meeting, or a cold chat, checking ICP fit, account ownership, intent history, and CRM state, then firing the right next step: enrolling a sequence in Salesloft, Outreach, or Gong Engage, notifying a rep, rescheduling a meeting, or sending a booking link.
You will own the full arc of a product bet: target customer, first audience, market and customer evidence, problem definition, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, success metrics, first adoption trigger, usage learning, and business outcome.
You will own the solution concept, meaning what we offer and how it is offered. You will not own solution architecture, implementation, or product enablement execution. You will partner closely with a Product Designer and a Product Engineering Lead to shape solutions that are valuable, coherent, and practical to deliver.
This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn complex workflows, data, and customer needs into clear product direction. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build products that solve real problems for sophisticated users and who measures success by whether customers actually adopt what gets built.

Own Orchestrator end to end, from market and customer evidence through adoption, iteration, and long-term business impact
Define the first audience for every bet and protect that focus as new requests, edge cases, and opportunities emerge
Identify the right problems to solve and turn signal detection, decisioning, and action-taking into clear product direction
Define value, viability, priority, and success metrics, including what should trigger first adoption
Monitor adoption and real usage after launch, then use what you learn to improve the product and shape what comes next
Keep signal types, decision logic, and external integrations coherent, so the system stays predictable and trustworthy as it grows
Partner with Product Design on the experience, first-use path, and product-side enablement
Partner with the Product Engineering Lead on solutions that are technically sound and practical to deliver
Prioritize ruthlessly and make clear calls when the problem is complex and the answer is not obvious
Hold a high standard for quality. You do not ship things you would not want to use yourself

Senior-level experience managing complex B2B SaaS products, with clear ownership of a product area or major initiatives
Strong product judgment, with the ability to find problems worth solving and make informed tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
Hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product work, with good judgment about where AI genuinely improves a product experience
The ability to simplify complexity and turn customer evidence, data, and technical constraints into clear product decisions
Deep curiosity about users and markets, and a habit of building conviction through direct evidence
Comfort in technical domains and credibility with technical users and engineering partners
A bias toward focus and shipping narrow to learn quickly
Experience working closely with Engineering, Design, and cross-functional partners in a fast-moving environment
The drive to build products that solve real problems and get used, not just shipped

Experience building or owning third-party integrations, especially with CRM, Sales Engagement, or conferencing platforms
Experience with lead routing, distribution, or assignment logic
Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms
Experience building enterprise-grade, data-rich SaaS products
Experience building or shipping with Claude or similar products
Who this role is for
This role is best suited to someone energized by high ownership, independent judgment, and making decisions without a playbook. We give people real responsibility and a lot of room to operate, which means you will be expected to run your area, set direction, and make hard calls with imperfect information.
If you are looking for a highly directed environment with a lot of structure around what to do next, this is probably not the right fit.
How this role works
We care deeply about clear ownership and close cross-functional partnership.
The Product Market Fitter owns the target customer, problem, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, adoption, and business result
The Product Designer owns the experience and product-side enablement
The Product Designer and Product Engineering Lead jointly own solution architecture
The Product Engineering Lead owns the technical solution and delivery execution

s.h: Why you'll love being a part of our team

Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future.
Work with an immensely talented global team

We lead by example--showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow--while having fun

Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we've been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.
Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. Unlimited vacation (and we do mean it, and we do take it!)

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.
We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.
As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value.

Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.
If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.
Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.
Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.
Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.
Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.
What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.
Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.
Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.
Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.
High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.
Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.
Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.
Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.
Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!
