Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is seeking a highly entrepreneurial and strategic Principal Product Manager to lead our Worker Safety initiative. This is a critical "zero-to-one" opportunity to take an early-access product and define its long-term market position. You will act as the single-threaded owner, providing the core strategy and market fit that this initiative needs to transition to a fully scalable business solution.
The ideal candidate is a relentless problem-solver—someone who can navigate an unscripted roadmap, engage directly with customers, and quantify the business opportunity with first-principles thinking.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

Customer Discovery & Immersion : Conduct intensive customer research onsite with our clientele. Learn their business to determine the go forward strategy of this product area.
Value Distillation : Translate complex customer feedback into a clear value proposition, identifying the specific financial "prize" and ROI associated with solving worker safety challenges.
Roadmap Architecture : Bridge the gap between firmware engineering and software execution to define and deliver the "Version 2" product roadmap.
Strategic Leadership : Evaluate the broader market landscape to determine Samsara's long-term "right to win" in this sector.
AI-Driven Prototyping : Leverage AI tools and creative visualizations to build demos and iterate on product concepts at high velocity.

Customer discovery and market validation through launch and scale.
Conduct deep market and user research to uncover unmet needs in physical operations and translate them into differentiated product opportunities.
Define and communicate a compelling product vision and roadmap that balances customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact.
Collaborate closely with engineering and design to build full-stack solutions, leveraging your technical understanding to make tradeoffs and accelerate delivery.
Partner with go-to-market teams (sales, customer success, marketing) to win strategic deals, scale adoption, and inform future product direction.
Establish success metrics, track performance, and iterate quickly to ensure products deliver measurable impact for customers and revenue growth for Samsara.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team).

Experience : 8+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of success in high-growth, scrappy environments.
Zero-to-One Mindset : Proven ability to build products from the ground up where no playbook exists.
Analytical Rigor : Exceptional first-principles thinking and the ability to quantify market opportunities and prioritize engineering directions based on conviction.
Communication : Strong ability to "pitch" a vision to internal stakeholders and external customers alike.
Technical Literacy : While a hardware background is not required, the candidate must be comfortable working closely with firmware engineers and technical teams.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

At Hightouch , our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.
About the Product Team
You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. The team prizes founder-level commercial instinct, the bandwidth to cover broad areas, and extremely fast iteration aided by product-minded engineers and AI. We’re the team that invented Reverse ETL, pioneered the Composable architecture, landed AI Decisioning as a category, and most recently invented Agentic Marketing.
Why this role matters
This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch 's revenue — and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We're hiring this role to change that: one person accountable for the health, direction, and growth of our core.
What you’ll own
We're looking for a product leader for the core surface area of Hightouch : the interfaces marketers live in every day and the largest driver of our revenue. You'll own a broad portfolio spanning:
Audiences — the segmentation and targeting experience at the center of Hightouch
Charts & Dashboards — analytics surfaces for customers to uncover audience insights and monitor performance
Experiments — automation and measurement tools to run & monitor cross-channel experiments
Trait Building — no-code interfaces to build custom business logic and data attributes to power marketing campaigns
Orchestration — primitives for how campaigns and journeys are sequenced and coordinated globally across all of Hightouch
We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio.

The role’s mandate spans multiple modes of product work: from 0-1 innovation to deepening established surfaces to scaling emerging areas. A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include:
Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs
Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions
Transforming our investment in charts, dashboards, and experimentation to better interface with Hightouch Agentic Marketing
This is a senior, hands-on role — think “product GM.” You'll be fully accountable for both product adoption and go-to-market success, leading across multiple Engineering and Design workstreams. You'll present frequently to customers, work directly with executives, and shape company strategy.

Customer Obsession: You are a relentless customer champion. Your superpower is the ability to forge deep connections, intuitively anticipating needs before customers can even articulate them.
Technical Aptitude: More than just understanding technical concepts, you're a translator who turns complex engineering challenges into elegant, accessible solutions. You speak both engineer and business fluently.
Strong Communicator: You can drive clarity and distill complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire teams and resonate with users, turning insights into action.
Hunger and Speed: Speed isn't just a preference for you—it's a way of life. You thrive in a high-energy environment where rapid iteration and bold moves are the default, not the exception.
Outcome Mindset: You're not a feature factory—you're a strategic mastermind who reverse-engineers success. Every decision you make is laser-focused on driving measurable business impact, turning product vision into tangible results.

Team mission
Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.

As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.
This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.
We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.

Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.
Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.
Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.
Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.
Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.
Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

6+ years of experience in product management , with a t least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.
A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.
Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.
Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the multi-year vision, roadmap, and performance for a key product area at Storyblok. You will own the what and the why around your products, from early discovery and definition through launch and improvement.

You will set standards across the product team, working closely with Engineering and Design to turn strategy into a clear delivery plan, make practical calls on scope and tradeoffs, and support teams all the way through to shipping.

You'll report on how your product area is performing, and represent that direction to executives, key customers, and industry analysts. You'll also partner closely with our Developer Experience team to make working with our APIs, SDKs, and docs something developers actively enjoy.

Product area vision & roadmap: Set the multi-year vision and own the roadmap for a key product area. Decide what gets built in what order across this area, and explain why you made those calls. Bring net-new product bets to the executive team when you spot one worth making.
Product Discovery: Set the research agenda across your area rather than running all of it yourself. Decide what needs investigating, commission the work, and spot market shifts before they show up in the numbers.
Developer experience. Treating docs, error messages, and the composable/MACH integration ecosystem as part of the product.
Business cases: Build company-level business cases, such as a new pricing tier or a new market, that hold up in front of leadership and show how product spend turns into results the business can measure.
Release strategy: Set the standards for how releases are governed across the company: what ships in what order, what has to be working before it does, and what every team needs in place to be ready.
Stakeholder management: Keep executives, key customers and industry analysts informed and on the same page as priorities shift.
Cross-team leadership: Become the leader in your area, shaping organisation-wide product culture. Arbitrate the conflicts and competing priorities that span whole orgs rather than passing them up the chain.
Metrics & measurement: Set the metrics and analytics standards other product areas work to, and report on how your own area is performing.
Design and engineering collaboration: Work closely with design and engineering from the first research through launch. You shape the design philosophy at the platform level and set the component and API conventions teams follow, they bring the craft and the technical judgement, and together you decide what ships, what waits, and how good it has to be.
Writing: Set the spec and writing standards other product teams work to, and write the internal docs that inform executive-level decisions.
External communication and launch stories: Represent the product narrative externally through keynotes and analyst briefings, and drive category-defining thought leadership.
Mentoring: Mentor across the product team, growing ownership and judgement in other PMs rather than making their calls for them.

8+ years in product management, at least 3 of them on technical, developer-facing, or platform products
Hands-on experience with developer tools, or platform products.
Experience owning a whole product area, not single features
Demonstrated technical fluency: you can read API documentation, run discovery interviews with senior engineers, and write a PRD that engineers respect.

Do work that matters.
At AlertMedia , we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.
Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:
We’re humans not robots
Customers always come first
We work better together
Simplicity is our strength
Our reputation is priceless
Hard work pays off
As one of the fastest growing software companies in the nation, we’re focused on finding the best talent and building the best team to continue accelerating our rapid growth to keep up with our demand. We’re also an AI-forward company, and we expect everyone on our team to use modern AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and optimize processes.
We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn real-world security expertise into Social Intelligence software that helps teams identify credible threats sooner and protect people when it matters most.

You have spent time in the seat we build for. You have monitored a developing situation with incomplete information, decided whether a signal was credible enough to escalate, and lived with the consequences of that call. You know the difference between noise and a genuine indicator, and you know how much of that work is still done by hand.
Now you want to solve those problems at scale for thousands of security teams instead of one. You are curious about how customers actually work rather than how they say they work, comfortable making decisions with imperfect data, and energized by turning a messy operational problem into software that ships. You are as interested in the practitioner’s daily reality as you are in the roadmap that serves it.
Risk Intelligence is one of the fastest-moving areas of our product. Open sources surface indicators of violence, unrest, executive targeting, brand-directed activity, and physical risk earlier than any other channel — and separating the meaningful few from the overwhelming many is the hard problem. You will own how AlertMedia solves it.

s.h: What you get to do every day
s.t:
Customer and Market Understanding
Develop deep expertise in the personas we serve — corporate security, intelligence analysts, executive protection, threat assessment, brand and communications teams — including how their work is structured, staffed, measured, and escalated.
Interview customers and prospects continuously. Run discovery conversations, ride-alongs, and feedback sessions that produce specific problem statements rather than feature requests.
Maintain a clear, current view of the problems we solve well today, where we can improve, and the problems we should be solving 12 to 24 months from now.
Track industry trends, threat landscape shifts, platform and data-access changes, regulatory developments, and the competitive field, and translate them into implications for our roadmap.
Prioritization and Roadmap Ownership
Own a value stream in the Risk Intelligence roadmap: decide what we build, what we defer, and what we decline, with reasoning that stands up to scrutiny.
Balance business objectives, customer needs, and industry trends when sequencing work, and make the tradeoffs explicit to stakeholders.
Define the problem sets and jobs to be done that anchor each initiative, so the team understands the outcome before it debates the solution.
Working With Development and Design
Partner with Engineering and Design to translate customer problems into specifications, acceptance criteria, and deliverable milestones the team can execute against.
Break large initiatives into releasable increments that produce customer value early and inform what comes next.
Stay close through delivery — grooming, scope decisions, testing, and launch readiness — and resolve ambiguity before it becomes rework.
Prototyping With AI Tooling
Use AI development and design tools such as Claude Code, Claude Design, and Codex to build working prototypes, pressure-test concepts, and put something tangible in front of customers in days rather than quarters.
Treat prototypes as a research method: use them to invalidate weak ideas inexpensively and to sharpen strong ones before Engineering commits.
Bring that fluency to the wider product team and raise the bar for how quickly we can move from idea to evidence.
Measurement
Define what success looks like before launch — adoption, analyst efficiency, signal quality, retention impact, revenue contribution — and instrument for it.
Analyze product usage data and customer outcomes after release, report honestly on what worked and what did not, and feed those findings into the next round of prioritization.
Go-To-Market Enablement
Work with Product Marketing to position new capabilities, shape messaging, and equip Sales, Customer Success, and Support to sell and support them with confidence.
Translate product functionality into narratives and practical applications that customer-facing teams can use in real conversations.
Lead internal training, demos, and Q&A sessions so the organization understands not just what shipped but why it matters to the people who use it.

s.h: What you bring to the role
s.t:
Operational experience protecting people, businesses, or brands — in corporate security, intelligence, threat assessment, executive protection, law enforcement, military, a global security operations center, or a comparable environment.
Hands-on experience using social and open-source threat intelligence products as a practitioner, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they fall short.
Working knowledge of manual open-source intelligence tradecraft — source discovery and validation, platform-specific search and Boolean logic, geolocation and imagery verification, persona and account analysis, and corroboration across sources.
Product management experience, or demonstrated ownership of a product-adjacent function such as intelligence program design, tooling selection, or internal capability building.
Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions from incomplete or conflicting information.
Advanced written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold a technical conversation with Engineering and a strategic one with an executive on the same day.
Comfort with tools like Jira, Confluence, and product analytics software.
A collaborative, no-ego approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Resourcefulness — you keep going when the path is not clear.
Energetic, empathetic, and earnest, with a consistent record of delivering quality work on schedule.
Bonus
Experience building or scaling an intelligence function, including analyst workflow design, reporting standards, and escalation criteria.
Familiarity with Agile delivery, APIs, system integrations, or data pipelines.
Exposure to threat assessment frameworks such as WAVR-21 or RAGE-V.
Experience with product enablement or go-to-market support.

This is not a “growth hacking” role or one that prioritizes revenue at the cost of the customer experience and trust — we care about building a durable growth engine by creating a magical customer experience and providing unreasonable hospitality.

Own landing pages, signup funnels, app download pages, including simplifying the user flow (insurance shopping is very complex and requires a lot of data inputs from the customer), personalizing the experience by user persona and marketing channel, building trust through designing delightful and helpful communication, copy and UI, etc

Who we get excited about
First principles thinker: You’re comfortable breaking ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before reaching for a solution, as well as working with incomplete information.
Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks.
Customer-centric: You find customer feedback intrinsically interesting and not some box to check. You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.
Strong communicator : You can work effectively across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing, including across time zones. You calibrate how much context others need and give it clearly.

About Schneider Geospatial
Schneider Geospatial is a leading PE-backed GovTech SaaS company transforming how governments serve their communities. Our GIS-based GovTech solutions power over 1,000 local governments across 34 states. We help public agencies streamline parcel management, permitting & licensing, and asset management, making government more transparent, efficient, and citizen focused.
Recognized multiple years as a Great Employer to Work For, we blend a purpose-driven mission with the innovation and agility of a high-growth software company. Schneider Geospatial has also been named GovTech 100 for four consecutive years, recognizing the most innovative and impactful companies serving the state and local government.
The Opportunity
We're seeking a Product Manager, Parcel Management, to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of one of Schneider Geospatial 's flagship product lines. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), you'll partner with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that help local governments manage parcel data, support property assessment and taxation workflows, and provide reliable public access to property information.
You'll combine strategic product thinking with a deep curiosity for how assessors, auditors, treasurers, GIS teams, and other local government professionals work, translating complex parcel and property-data challenges into intuitive, scalable software that improves accuracy, efficiency, and transparency.
This is a unique opportunity to own a high-impact product in a PE-backed company entering an exciting phase of growth and modernization. You'll shape product strategy, influence customer outcomes, and help define the next generation of parcel management and public access solutions.

Mission + Impact: Build technology that helps local governments better serve citizens and businesses.
Ownership + Innovation: Lead a flagship product with meaningful ownership and strategic influence.
Growth + Learning: Partner with experienced product and executive leaders committed to mentorship and professional development.
Culture + Collaboration: Join a company recognized for its values-driven culture, collaborative environment, and relentless focus on customer success.
Compensation + Opportunity: Competitive salary, benefits, and clear pathways toward senior product leadership.

Product Strategy & Vision
Define and execute the product vision for Schneider Geospatial 's Parcel Management solutions.
Partner with the CPO and executive leadership to align product strategy with company objectives and market opportunities.
Translate customer feedback, market trends, evolving data standards, and competitive insights into a compelling product roadmap.
Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI, automation, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to modernize parcel workflows, improve data quality, and create meaningful customer value.
Serve as the internal and external subject matter expert for parcel data management, property assessment and taxation workflows, GIS integration, and public property-information access.
Execution & Delivery
Collaborate closely with Engineering to translate product strategy into actionable user stories, features, and technical priorities.
Manage product backlogs and drive execution using Agile methodologies.
Partner with Customer Success and Implementation teams to ensure successful product adoption and measurable customer outcomes.
Develop data-driven business cases for new features and enhancements that improve data quality, customer outcomes, and business value.
Support Sales and Marketing through product demonstrations, competitive positioning, launch planning, and customer education.
Leverage AI-enabled tools, product analytics, customer insights, and experimentation to accelerate product discovery, improve decision-making, and continuously enhance the user experience.
Customer & Market Insight
Build strong relationships with customers to understand parcel-data workflows, operational challenges, statutory requirements, integration needs, and opportunities for innovation.
Monitor product performance, industry trends, data standards, legislation, and competitive offerings to inform ongoing product strategy.
Represent Schneider Geospatial at customer meetings, assessor and GIS conferences, user groups, and industry events as a trusted product leader.

Our Product Managers are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable defining long-term vision while diving into product details that create exceptional customer experiences. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, solving complex business problems, and building products customers genuinely love.
5+ years of product management experience, ideally within SaaS, GovTech, workflow automation, or business process software.
Experience with parcel management, property assessment or taxation, cadastral GIS, land records, public records access, or related local government technologies strongly preferred.
Proven ability to translate customer and data-workflow needs into product strategy, roadmaps, and feature prioritization.
Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering on modern SaaS products, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architectures, and web applications; ability to engage credibly in technical tradeoff discussions without needing to be an engineer.
Familiarity with modern SaaS architectures (.NET, C#, JavaScript, SQL) and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
Understanding of modern web application frameworks (Angular, React) and user experience principles.
Strong analytical mindset with experience using customer, product, and data-quality metrics to drive product decisions.
Curiosity and practical fluency with AI and emerging technologies, with the ability to evaluate where new capabilities can meaningfully improve customer workflows, product experiences, and business outcomes.
Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Public Administration, GIS, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Your Future with Us
As Product Manager for Parcel Management, you'll shape the future of one of Schneider Geospatial 's most strategic product lines while helping local governments modernize parcel operations and make property information more accessible to their communities.
This role offers significant visibility across the executive team, opportunities to influence company-wide product strategy, and a clear path toward Senior Product Manager, Director of Product Management, or broader product leadership as Schneider Geospatial continues its growth.

FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion
Ebury London Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week
As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a platform-led product company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.
Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.
Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.
This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.
You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:
CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
Data and Analytics
Design and Engineering
Compliance and Risk
Clients directly

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:
Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows
The path from spot client → Hedge-active → policy client, and every drop-off point along it
Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference
Decision Tools for Clients
Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one
Tooling for CPMs
Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them
Repeat Hedging & Policy
Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact
Experimentation & Measurement
A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it
What success looks like (12-18 months)
Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion
What makes this role hard
You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

We power people’s progress.
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
What you'll be doing day to day
Own the Lesson Insights product end to end. Strategy, roadmap, execution, and results for one of Preply's flagship AI experiences - across learners and tutors, web and mobile.
Make feedback learners actually act on. The core job of Insights is to help learners improve. That means ruthless prioritization of what feedback to show, when, and how - not showing everything the models can detect.
Connect insights to progress. Learners don't just want feedback on one lesson, they want to know they're getting better. You'll shape how per-lesson insights look, and structure how they ladder up into progress over time, working closely with the Progress squad.
Bring tutors into the loop. Insights work best when they strengthen the learner-tutor relationship. You'll design for both sides of the marketplace.
Drive reach. Maximize how many learners benefit from Insights by scaling to other languages.
Drive engagement. Maximize feature retention via useful & engaging design that makes users want to check their insights after every lesson..
Go into the data yourself. Pull your own analyses on how learners engage with feedback, what drives repeat usage, and where the experience is falling flat.
What you'll need
Must-haves
Consumer product craft. Substantial experience building consumer-facing, mobile-first products with frequent, habitual use. You have a keen eye for design and care about the details of a delightful experience.
GenAI / LLM product experience. You have shipped products built on LLMs or NLP at scale, and can discuss trade offs & approaches with the team - evals, hallucinations, quality variance, latency, cost - and how to design around them.
Learner and tutor empathy. You are genuinely curious about the people using your product and bring that into every prioritization call.
Deeply data-driven. You go into the data yourself, find the signal, and build a point of view from scratch. You do not wait to be handed an analysis.
Experimentation rigor. Solid grounding in A/B testing, experiment design, and how to read results without fooling yourself.
Strong communication. You can turn complex, ambiguous work into a clear point of view that drives decisions at the leadership level.
Bias for action. You balance conviction-building with quick, lean hypothesis testing - ship the MVP, learn, iterate.
Comfort with ambiguity. You can make fuzzy things measurable and drive alignment on what good looks like.
Experience with learning languages
Nice-to-haves
EdTech or learning science background (CEFR, assessment, feedback design)
Experience with unstructured data - text, audio, transcripts
Experience with habit-forming products and behavioural psychology
Our Principles
Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. About Voodoo
Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.
Team
Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.
Voodoo is creating a new Studio with a big mission: find the next best way to entertain the world by taking our best hits to a new level. You will join a small team that is growing, composed of veterans from the industry, where you will participate in every aspect of development.
The Studio is working on refreshing and expanding one of our top legacy games. This game has already achieved great success, and we're eager to build on that momentum to (i) deploy learnings to more portfolio games and (ii) obtain a moonshot outcome; Paper.io & Hole.io are good such past examples.
Role
As a Product Manager for one of our Puzzle Studio, you will be at the heart of the game's evolution. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, artists, and product experts to design, test, and refine features that keep our players engaged and entertained.
Participate in the design and creation of engaging, challenging, and fun levels that maintain player interest and progression
Develop and iterate on game mechanics and features that enhance the core gameplay loop
Analyze player behavior, game metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement
Collaborate with engineers and artists to bring level designs and features to life
Structure, run, and monitor A/B tests to validate design decisions and optimize player experience
Balance game difficulty curves to ensure appropriate challenge and retention across all levels
Stay up-to-date with the hybrid-casual and puzzle game market, analyzing competitor games and emerging trends
Test and playtest levels and features to ensure quality and enjoyment
Contribute to the product roadmap and strategic direction
Work iteratively, rapidly prototyping ideas and incorporating feedback from the team and data
Profile
2+ years of professional experience in game design, product specialist, or similar role in the mobile gaming industry
Strong passion for mobile puzzle and hybrid-casual games, with a deep understanding of what makes them engaging and successful
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven design decisions
Understanding of player psychology and what drives engagement, retention, and satisfaction in puzzle games
Strong communication skills and ability to clearly articulate design ideas to cross-functional teams
Iterative mindset with the ability to rapidly test, learn, and improve designs based on feedback
Fluent in English
Bonus: Experience with Unity or game development tools, knowledge of A/B testing methodologies, experience shipping successful mobile games

About Solace
Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.
We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.
Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.
Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here .

This is a rare chance to learn product management from the inside out at one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the country. As an Associate Product Manager at Solace, you’ll help shape how millions of people experience healthcare while working side-by-side with designers, engineers, clinicians, and product leaders.
Your job is to help us make healthcare feel human again. You’ll research, organize, and test ideas, build new features, and help us launch faster. You don’t need years of experience, but you do need an innate ability to get things done.
This role is for the ambitious, the curious and those who don't shy away from feedback. If you’re the kind of person who sees a problem and can’t resist solving it, keep reading.
This is an in-person role for new college graduates in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week. Start date: July 2027.

Bring bold ideas and (occasionally) watch them get destroyed in the name of better ones.
Rapidly produce and launch concepts while laughing in the face of potential failure.
Partner with engineers, designers, and clinicians to deliver meaningful improvements for patients and advocates.
Keep projects moving forward, make sure deadlines are hit, and translate chaos into constant clarity.
Test, document, and ship features that make Solace better every week.
Grow your craft: learn how to write specs, analyze data, talk to users, and make smart product decisions.

About Eucalyptus
We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.
Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.
Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

s.h: About the role (What you'll be doing)
s.t:
We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Insights. You’ll build the personalised health layer that turns each patient’s data into visible progress, progress into insight, and insight into the next action; helping more of our patients get healthier, for life.
Weight-loss medications are the biggest shift in metabolic health care this generation has seen. But the support around the medication dictates whether our patients lose the weight in a healthy manner and are able to keep the weight off.

Our high-touch, proactive support model is the key reason why Juniper has become a market leader, and Insights is the core engine that powers it: getting our patients the right insight, the right intervention, at exactly the right moment. We believe we're still early on what's possible here.
As a Lead Product Manager, you'll set the vision and strategy for Insights across Juniper and our brands, and you'll be accountable for the engagement, retention and patient-outcome metrics that flow from it.

This includes shaping the features that help us better understand our patients — including weight tracking, body composition tracking, progress photos, nutrition tracking, sleep and more.

You'll work hand-in-hand with our Chief Commercial Officer, Principal Product Manager, clinical leadership, design, data science and engineering to shape and deliver ambitious bets.
The rewards for getting this right are meaningful. You'll see the results of your work reflected in the lives of the patients we change, replicated on a global scale.

Lead The Vision & Roadmap: Working with the Chief Commercial Officer & Principal Product Manager, shape the vision for Insights that power our patient’s proactive care. Set the direction and define the bets we make
Execute Quickly, Deliver Globally: Design experiences that make a patient feel their progress and drive engagement, habit formation and long-term retention. Take products from idea to impact and ship them to patients across every market Juniper and future brands operate in. You'll own delivery end-to-end and stay close to the craft
Drive Patient Outcomes, Engagement & Retention: Own your key engagement and retention metrics, connecting product decisions to real health outcomes and commercial impact. You’ll use data and patient insight to understand what's working and what needs to change.
Raise Bar On Craft: Partner closely with design and clinicians to set a high standard for quality, so every insight feels intuitive, trustworthy and distinctly Juniper.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align clinicians, data, design and engineering, and partner with senior stakeholders to unblock execution and deliver cohesive end-to-end outcomes.

AI has changed what it means to be a Product Manager, so we are very open to what background you come from. You’ve likely built your experience over 5+ years across:
Product Management, with ownership of consumer-facing, high-engagement product domains
Professional Services (like top-tier management consultancies, legal firms)
Other roles within a high-growth startup, or founded your own startup
Ultimately, we’re looking for a high-agency individual that spikes on the following qualities:
First-principles problem solver — You are able to break ambiguous problems down, build a clear and focussed strategy around it, and able to take something from idea to impact while applying clear judgement on tradeoffs along the way
Commercial & analytical rigour — You are laser-focused on delivering outcomes. You design for outcomes you can measure, interpret both quantitative and qualitative signal, and won't mistake motion for progress
Product sense — You have a real instinct and empathy for what makes a person feel something. You can tell the difference between a feature that's “works” and one that lands, and you have a strong intuition for what makes products feel delightful, trustworthy and easy to use
Ownership and comfort with ambiguity — you're energised by ambiguous, high-impact, undefined problems, and you've got a track record of navigating and leading through ambiguity
Influence without authority — You have a track record of building credibility and follower-ship amongst teams and stakeholders, built off the consistency and quality of your judgement, storytelling ability, and long-term relationship building
Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics ( Pilot, Kin , Software , Compound ) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

s.h: Here’s what makes joining Euc unique
s.t:
What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.
What’s ahead in Australia?
Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.
Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.
Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.
Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500.

Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

AlphaSense’s Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions.

Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.

Within Product, the SuperAnalyst team builds agentic finance capabilities, at the heart of our research suite—reusable, validated workflows that productize the repeatable work of a financial analyst (from surfacing the key debates on a company to building estimate forecasts), organized by financial persona with a dedicated owner accountable for each persona’s roadmap, builds, and quality bar.
If you’re passionate about creating industry-leading AI applications that shape the future of finance, we’d love to meet you.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own how SuperAnalyst serves bankers in an AI-first world. Your value lies in your experience on the desk at a top-tier investment bank: you understand the pressure, the workflows—from pitch and CIM prep to live deal execution—and the friction points that exist today.
As the owner of the Investment Banking persona, you will set the IB skill roadmap, teach our AI to think like a banker, and own the quality bar for everything that ships under IB. You will build the hardest skills yourself, guide contributors and our Forward Deployed Bankers, and fold what they learn in the field back into the library. You own what ships, and it reaches bankers on live deals across our customer base.

Own the IB roadmap & champion the customer: Act as the voice of the banker—translate deep knowledge of IB workflows (modeling, valuation, comps, M&A, capital markets) into a prioritized skill roadmap that solves the most acute pain points from analyst to MD.
Lead AI prompt engineering & validation: Be the primary architect of “quality” for IB—design, test, and refine skills so outputs meet the standard of a professional banker; you can look at an AI model or comp set and immediately know if it is MD-ready, and you hold every IB skill to our three-gate evaluation.
Guide contributors & forward-deployed engagements: Crowd source ideas for new capabilities from our “boots on the ground” customer success team and backstop the Forward Deployed Bankers on hard, account-specific builds, then fold the best features back into the core library.
Collaborate across teams: Work side-by-side with Engineering, Design, Sales Enablement, and Strategic Initiatives, bridging the gap between technical capability and business value.
Drive continuous improvement: Relentlessly push for better accuracy and speed, testing IB skills against real deal scenarios to ensure reliability.
Special projects: Develop advanced agentic architectures (e.g. AI slide deck creation) and design systems that abstract product development practices such as knowledge graphs, automated feedback systems, and no-code workflow builders.

Domain expert: 3+ years as an analyst, associate, or beyond in investment banking (M&A, coverage, capital markets, or leveraged finance) at a top-tier firm; you have lived the workflow and understand the nuance of financial data and deliverables.
AI enthusiast & practitioner: You have a strong grasp of Generative AI, are comfortable with vibe coding, prompt engineering, and understand the limitations of LLMs and how to work around them. Hands-on experience building with AI is a strong plus.
Strategic thinker: You can look at a manual process you used to do—spreading comps, building an LBO, drafting a CIM—and visualize exactly how AI should automate it, and in what order it is worth building.
Clear communicator: You can articulate complex banking concepts to engineers and designers who may not have a finance background, and carry credibility from the analyst bullpen to the MD’s office.

Who are we?
Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.
Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.
Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.
We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.
Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.
This role sits within our Peoplefun studio.
PeopleFun is an award-winning creator of mobile games for players across the globe. We are part of the AppLovin studios family, a publicly traded company, with world-class projects, resources, and infrastructure.

PeopleFun is a Dallas-based game studio founded and maintained by game industry veterans, where game developers thrive on collaboration, creativity, teamwork and fun. Our games are played by over 25 million players each month, and we have a number of exciting mid-core and casual games in development.

Our mission is twofold: excellence in creativity and data-driven product innovation, and to be a best-in-class workplace providing unique opportunities to learn and exercise curiosity.

PeopleFun is seeking a Lead Product Manager to drive audience growth, monetization, retention, and engagement across our game portfolio. Working closely with Production, Design, Engineering, and Analytics, you will lead a cross-functional product pod, own and prioritize the roadmap, and drive measurable improvements in game performance.

You will use data and player insights to identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, make product decisions, and determine where the team can have the greatest impact.

Lead product management and cross-functional pod execution on Wordscapes.
Take responsibility for the growth of the game, with a focus on improving new user retention.
Own and prioritize the product roadmap to achieve player and business goals.
Own key game KPIs, proactively identifying opportunities and driving initiatives to improve performance.
Collaborate with studio stakeholders to define, design, and manage features that drive engagement, retention, and monetization.
Design and balance game economies to drive compelling player experiences, retention, and monetization.
Perform game analytics and translate player behavior and performance data into clear product decisions and priorities.
Develop data-backed hypotheses, define success metrics, and use test results to iterate, scale, or deprioritize initiatives.
Analyze competing games and provide relevant competitive insights and references.
Leverage liveops tools, A/B testing, local/push notifications, and other tools to optimize player experience and drive business objectives.

Bachelor’s Degree (graduate degree preferred) in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or related field.
3+ years' experience in a game product management role.
Proven experience in increasing user retention.
Passion for creating innovative, fun, and compelling games.
Understanding and experience with free-to-play and other mobile game business and monetization models.
Proactive and self-directed, with a track record of identifying opportunities and driving them forward without waiting for direction.
Highly data-driven, with the ability to develop hypotheses, analyze player and game performance, and translate insights into product decisions.
Experience with A/B and multivariate testing.
Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, with the ability to focus teams on the highest-impact opportunities.
Strong critical thinking, attention to detail, and communication skills.
Ability to travel to the Dallas office 3-4 times per year.

Generous Vacation Time - Employees receive 25 vacation days annually, in addition to statutory holidays.

RRSP Matching - We match 100% of employee RRSP contributions up to 3.5% of annual salary, helping you build long-term financial security.
Employee Assistance Program - Confidential support and resources are available whenever needed through our Employee Assistance Program.
Hybrid Work Environment - We operate on a hybrid work model, with in-office collaboration Monday through Thursday and a flexible work-from-home day on Fridays. Employees also enjoy complimentary breakfast, lunch and evening snacks on all office days.
Team Events & Celebrations - We regularly host social events and celebrations to recognize achievements, strengthen connections, and build a positive workplace culture.
Professional Development - We are committed to employee growth and encourage career advancement through ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.

s.h: The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios
s.t:
Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses.
Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart.

The Engineering Product Manager serves as the bridge between Engineering and Game Product teams. This role partners closely with engineering leads and game product managers to understand business and technical needs, gather requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop roadmaps for internal engineering initiatives. The ideal candidate is technically proficient enough to communicate effectively with engineers while translating technical work into clear business value for stakeholders.

Partner with engineering leads and game product managers to gather requirements, identify opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and support roadmap planning for engineering initiatives.
Own and maintain the backlog for internal engineering products and platforms.
Facilitate communication between Engineering, Game Product, QA, Analytics, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment throughout the product lifecycle.
Translate business and technical needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and functional specifications.
Coordinate feature development, project timelines, releases, and stakeholder communications.
Provide recommendations on priorities based on business value, engineering effort, and stakeholder feedback.
Define success metrics and monitor product performance to drive continuous improvements.
Establish and maintain standards for product requirements, documentation, release notes, and user guides to ensure consistency across engineering initiatives.
Facilitate roadmap reviews, planning sessions, and cross-functional meetings.
Identify opportunities to improve internal tools, workflows, and engineering processes.

3+ years of Product Management experience, preferably supporting technical products or engineering teams.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and modern software development practices.
Comfortable discussing technical concepts including Unity, JavaScript, APIs, backend services, cloud infrastructure, mobile applications, and game development.
Ability to understand technical tradeoffs and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience writing product requirements and maintaining product documentation.

Experience in the mobile gaming industry.
Experience with internal developer tools, SDKs, LiveOps, analytics platforms, or backend systems.
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
Previous technical experience is a plus but not required.

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.
Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.
In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.
At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.
Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

In this role, you will be responsible for driving the definition, development, and delivery of Wayve’s L4 autonomous driving solutions. You will own key product initiatives from concept through deployment, aligning Wayve’s AV2.0-based approach with OEMs, operational partners, and various other stakeholders.
As a Product Manager, you will work cross-functionally with R&D, safety, validation, and commercial teams to shape a scalable, reliable, user-centric AV product strategy. Your role will be essential in translating cutting-edge technical innovation—particularly in embodied AI and end-to-end learning—into market-ready features and capabilities. You will champion our customers and work in the intersection of consumer and deep tech, particularly in human interactions with embodied AI .

Define and own the product roadmap for Level 4 autonomous driving features, aligning with company strategy, customer needs, and regulatory frameworks.
Work closely with design, system architects, software developers, validation teams, and safety experts to ensure delivery of safe and delightful customer experiences.
Take full end-to-end ownership of AV feature development, from concept definition through implementation, validation, and deployment in production.
Stay current with global AV trends, regulatory developments, and competitors to take the best product decisions.
Support verification & validationAct as the product lead in internal reviews and external engagements.
In order to set you up for success as a Product manager at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Proven track record of technical product management experience, shipping products with a consumer mindset in a very technical domain.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to work in cross-functional teams
Strong technical background in AI/ML, software engineering, robotics, or a related discipline.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments with evolving priorities.
Full Fluency in Japanese and English
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience owning end-to-end delivery of AV features, including collaboration with engineering, systems, safety, and validation teams.
Understanding of human-machine interaction (HMI), UX, or the broader robotaxi product
Knowledge of generative AI techniques, LLMs, or Software 2.0 methods as applied to autonomous driving or large-scale simulation.
Analytical, data driven
This is a full-time role based in our office in Yokohama / Tokyo, Japan. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. We operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.
Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.
We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
For more information visit Careers at Wayve.
To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve
For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work
