However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
Product Owner – Automated Insights Innovation
Primary Purpose
As a Product Owner, you will support the ongoing development and enhancement of the Automated Insights prototype application across its lifecycle. You will help identify and build use cases that turn insights into measurable operational improvements, creating capabilities for customer demonstrations and future integration into NiCE production products.
This is a hands-on product role . You will define and maintain a focused roadmap under the direction of product leadership while also building the application. This includes front-end development, API and connector integrations, maintaining and refactoring existing and AI-generated code, and connecting analytics outputs to application workflows.
You will also serve as a central resource as prototype capabilities move toward production, partnering with Research, Product, Services, Design, Engineering, and other teams to ensure successful transition and avoid rediscovery. Customer and field feedback will help inform roadmap and prioritization decisions.
The ideal candidate combines product judgment with hands-on technical skills. They are comfortable with ambiguity, energized by AI-assisted development, able to prioritize with incomplete information, and comfortable working across technical and business teams.

Own the Automated Insights prototype across definition, planning, release, enhancements, and maintenance.
Define and maintain a focused roadmap and prioritize functionality under product leadership.
Build new features and application modules from prototypes and specifications.
Maintain, refactor, and improve existing and AI-generated code.
Build data visualizations and dashboard-style interfaces from designs.
Develop and manage API, webhook, and connector integrations.
Connect Python-based analytics outputs to application workflows.
Support prototype capabilities as they transition into production, partnering with cross-functional teams.
Document functionality, dependencies, limitations, and technical considerations for receiving teams.
Support customer-facing demonstrations, troubleshooting, and rapid issue resolution.
Capture feedback from customers, field teams, and product teams to inform prioritization.
Support application scalability, performance, reliability, version control, and CI/CD practices.
Support other innovation projects, prototypes, solutions, and deployments as needed.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Intelligence/Analytics, or a related field.
Equivalent practical experience in a hands-on product or software development role may be considered in place of a degree.
Required Experience/Skills
3+ years of combined experience in product ownership, product management, or hands-on application development, including ownership through multiple release cycles.
Experience defining and prioritizing a roadmap and making trade-off decisions with incomplete information.
Hands-on experience with GenAI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar.
Proficiency in JavaScript and modern front-end frameworks, preferably React, including HTML and CSS.
Experience building data visualizations or dashboard-style interfaces.
Experience with REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, and connector integrations.
Working knowledge of Python sufficient to read analytics code and interpret data science outputs.
Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices.
Ability to take ownership of and improve code they did not originally write.
Familiarity with rapid prototyping tools and practices.
Experience partnering cross-functionally to move concepts into production.
Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to a changing environment.

Experience moving prototypes or proof-of-concepts into production.
Experience with Customer Experience, Contact Center, CCaaS, WEM, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
Exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, or outbound engagement platforms such as Cognigy, Verse, or similar.
Experience supporting customer demonstrations, pilots, or proof-of-concept work.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other reasonable related duties as assigned. NiCE reserves the right to revise or change job duties as business needs arise.

About NiCE
NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.
Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

s.h: WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​
s.t:
What you will focus on
Responsible for supporting the design and optimization of revenue strategies and helping adjust the balance between engaging player experiences and effective monetization models.
By proposing improvements to the product strategy based on player behavior and data analysis, A/B testing, and market research and through coordinated efforts with production and monetization teams (design, developer, marketing, live ops, data analysis, and economy design).
What it means on a daily basis​
Performances analysis
Identify the features, game modes, and player behaviors that need to be analyzed, and prioritize the areas with the highest impact.
Work with the DA team to conduct structured data analysis, from problem definition to recommendations.
Build and maintain shared performance dashboards and prepare monthly reports/product reviews to track KPIs and game performance against revenue and profitability targets.
Engagement Metrics and Monetization
Run A/B tests on events, offers, and shop configurations to improve engagement and monetization performance across player segments.
Document testing history, results, and key learnings; propose new features and improvements to increase monetization.
Review the GDD and support forecasting, post-launch performance tracking, and optimization recommendations, including initiatives to increase new and returning users.
Product Vision and Strategy
Use performance analysis to support the GM in defining the product vision, direction, and key focus areas for the coming year(s).
Help define the strategy and quarterly objectives needed to bring the vision to life, including the scope of each update.
Share product and monetization insights with the team to improve alignment, ownership, and commitment to the product’s evolution.
Recruitment Journey
Only candidates whose qualifications align with the role will be contacted. We sincerely appreciate your understanding.
(1) Screening call with HR (30 mins)
(2) Test
(3) Interview(s)
(4) Offer
Where this role can take you
This role offers versatile growth opportunities, allowing you to advance vertically into Senior Product Manager, Producer, or Senior Producer.

Experience in Product Management, Live Operation, Analytics, Monetization, or Consulting in product-oriented roles; gaming experience.
Good knowledge of top-grossing games and free-to-play (F2P) mechanics, with experience on at least 2 different titles, including one Live Game operated as a service.
Solid analytical and data modeling skills, with solid proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and basic knowledge of SQL, Python, or R.
A Bachelor’s degree in a related field; a Master’s degree and game design or game creation experience.

Detail-oriented, well-organized, and capable of performing effectively in a changing work setting.
Experienced at analyzing large datasets and turning them into actionable insights.
Someone who works well with others and has effective leadership and communication skills.
Motivated by video games and able to combine creative thinking with data-driven decision-making.

A hybrid working model (5 working days per week – max 3 days WFH) ​
A range of well-being events and policies to support employees (leave scheme, medical check-up, wellness gift, wedding/condolences, etc.)
An attractive salary package with full salary for probation period​
Monthly lunch allowance and home office support​

Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave,... ​
100% coverage of mandatory insurance and extra healthcare insurance. ​
Various training packages, including internal training, sponsorship training, and e-learning (iLearn, Udemy, O’Reilly, ...). ​
Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourselves. ​
Relocation support for international candidates joining from overseas.

Lieu : Nantes
Type de contrat : CDI
Rémunération : 38K€ à 45K€
Démarrage : Immédiat
Expérience requise : A partir de 5 ans
En tant que Product Owner , vous contribuerez à l'évolution d’un écosystème public en transformation et piloterez des produits numériques stratégiques.
Missions
Accompagner le client dans la création d’une vision claire du produit et la communiquer aux équipes
Définir la feuille de route de la conception de ce produit et s’assurer du respect des échéances
Animer des ateliers pour définir les fonctionnalités, les prioriser et les concevoir
Découper et rédiger les fonctionnalités en user stories
Planifier les itérations avec l’équipe de développement, insérer les user stories dans les sprints en coordination avec les autres PO
Piloter le développement et le déploiement des fonctionnalités, valider les livraisons partielles ou finales, en porter la communication devant les autres parties prenantes
Préparer, piloter et mener à bien la conduite du changement autour du produit (communication rédaction de documentation, formations…)
Déployer et appliquer une démarche itérative, d’amélioration continue et de conseil
Assurer la conformité du projet et du produit aux normes qualité définies avec le client
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que PO ou PPO sur des projets build
Bonne connaissance des méthodes agiles
Capacité à arbitrer entre valeur utilisateur, faisabilité technique, délais et contraintes budgétaires.
Une expérience dans un environnement public, parapublic ou à fort niveau de coordination institutionnelle serait un plus

Accord annualisation du temps de travail (9 à 10 jours de RTT)
Accord télétravail
Tickets restaurants
